searchText: Hi everyone!, I'm Kodey. I'm a backend developer from the UK I've been coding for ~5 years. Used to do iOS Tweak Development + a tiny bit of security research but now i primarily do backend web development 🙂 hello! I'm a nerd. I enjoy computer science. Degrees in Accounting, Economics, and Computer Science. Been playing with Eth stuff for a couple years as a hobby. Getting up to date with the research propositions during my lunch breaks! I have ideas on how to maybe help with scalability; excited to learn why my ideas are shit. 🙂
